The '''Kemix system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Yminis sector/Legends|Yminis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained at least three barren [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Kemix]]. It was marked on all galactic navigational charts as uninhabited and unremarkable. However, Kemix was occupied during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and became the site of a [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation, run by [[Riboga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. His [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Rightful Dominion]]'', also traveled to the system.
